St Johns Investment Management Company Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. St Johns Investment Management Company Llc sold 2,457 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 23,397 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.96 million, down from 25,854 at the end of the previous reported quarter. St Johns Investment Management Company Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.95B market cap company.
